name: Chantal Senn
bio_de: As a plant-based systems enthusiast, Chantal Senn has discovered a whole new world of possibilities for change. Her studies have taught her how deeply ecosystems and animals matter, yet she sees a different reality every day in the canteen. That gap is exactly what drives her: turning what she learns into real, lived change.
